text: FilmCraft 是面向 DSH 的视频制作插件，提供可视化 Web 编辑器和原生剪辑工作流。它通过 MCP 工具打开编辑器、导入素材、运行编辑命令并保存工程；工作流可从已有素材组织时间线、分离音轨、添加和设置字幕、处理局部镜头修订，并在导出后检查文件。适合需要把素材整理成可继续编辑的短片、访谈或多机位项目的创作者。运行前需准备授权的素材读取目录和结果写入目录；安装时会从 GitHub 下载校验锁定的 FilmCraft runtime，不需要额外 API Key。

FilmCraft adds a browser editor and native video workflows to DSH. Import footage, edit timelines and captions, save reopenable projects, and check exported files. Workflows need authorized media read and output directories. Setup downloads a pinned runtime from GitHub; no API key is needed.

FilmCraft 的功能「浏览器编辑与项目文件」：通过 MCP 打开可见 Web 编辑器，导入工作区素材、运行编辑器命令并把工程保存到工作区新路径。
FilmCraft 的功能「原生时间线剪辑与字幕」：提交剪辑计划后，工作流可处理素材、时间线和字幕，并保存、重开工程以核对结果。
FilmCraft 的功能「导出与成片检查」：工作流生成媒体输出，并包含导出后的解码检查步骤，便于确认输出文件可读取。

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · Positioning：FilmCraft Use edits video as a native, reopenable project rather than a rendered file. It probes your media, assembles tracks on an exact integer tick base, keeps voice-over, music and source audio separate, treats captions as editable text with timing and style, and finishes only after the exported file has been decoded and checked for duration, size and audio.

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · Positioning：The plugin plans and verifies; the pinned FilmCraft CLI performs the native edit. Long-form command coverage, physical GUI input and other platforms are not qualified, and every write must stay inside the read and write roots you explicitly authorize.

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · Prerequisites：- macOS arm64. Other platforms return `unsupported_platform`; do not install a foreign artifact.
- Python 3.11 or newer on `PATH` for the public scripts; the launcher provisions the pinned runtime in the user data directory.
- Node.js 24 or newer for the embedded editor MCP server. A Git checkout has no `ui/dist/`; build it per `ui/README.md` or install a release bundle.
- Explicit authorization roots. `workflow.py` and `commands.py run` require `--read-root` and `--write-root` (repeatable); they must be existing canonical directories named by you, never derived from a plan or from asset metadata.

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · Configuration：Timeline positions use `254016000000` ticks per second. Workflow templates carry large integers as decimal strings; native command ticks stay exact JSON integers and never pass through a lossy JavaScript number.

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · Architecture and security：- Root isolation is enforced for macOS headless execution. The desktop entry must additionally isolate the signed app it owns and expose only its assigned loopback control port; an external bridge that cannot prove isolation is refused.
- Media, music and voice are separate identities with separate gains. Voices are never synthesized or uploaded without authorization.
- Writes require `--save` or `--save-as`, or one `run`/MCP session. A timeout never proves that no side effect happened: check the project, the export or the task first.
- See [execution permissions](skills/filmcraft-use/references/execution-permissions.md), [runtime architecture](docs/FilmCraft-Runtime-Architecture.md) and [domain design](docs/FilmCraft-Domain-Design.md).

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Action |
|:---|:---|
| `unsupported_platform` | Only the locked macOS arm64 artifact is supported |
| Root rejection | `--read-root` / `--write-root` must be existing canonical directories you named; they cannot come from the plan |
| `runtime_install_busy` | Another install holds the lock; wait for it, then retry |
| `--help` prints nothing useful | This CLI uses `help` |
| Command lost an object id | Read the real result or stay in one MCP/`run` session; never guess ids |
| Export looks finished but is not | Decode the file and check duration, dimensions and audio track |
| Unknown result after a save | Inspect the original project and receipts; do not resubmit blindly |

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · 项目定位：FilmCraft Use 把视频当作可重新打开的原生工程来剪，而不是一个渲染结果。它探测素材、在精确的整数 tick 时间基上组织轨道、让配音、音乐与原声各自保持独立身份、把字幕当作带时间与样式的可编辑文本，并且只有在导出文件被解码并核对时长、尺寸与音轨之后才算完成。

插件负责规划与核验，原生剪辑由固定的 FilmCraft CLI 完成。长片命令覆盖、物理 GUI 输入与其他平台都尚未取得资格，所有写入必须落在你显式授权的读根与写根之内。

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · 前置条件：- macOS arm64。其他平台返回 `unsupported_platform`，不要安装其他平台制品。
- 公开脚本需要 `PATH` 上有 Python 3.11 或更新版本；启动器会在用户数据目录准备固定运行时。
- 内嵌编辑器 MCP 服务需要 Node.js 24 或更新版本。Git 检出没有 `ui/dist/`，需先按 `ui/README.md` 构建，或安装发布包。
- 必须显式授权读写根。`workflow.py` 与 `commands.py run` 要求 `--read-root` 与 `--write-root`（可重复），且必须是你指定的已存在规范目录，不能从计划或素材元数据推导。

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · 架构与安全：- 根隔离在 macOS headless 执行下强制执行。桌面入口还必须隔离它拥有的签名应用，且只开放分配的 loopback 控制端口；无法证明隔离的外部 bridge 会被拒绝。
- 素材、音乐与配音是相互独立的身份，各自保留增益。未经授权不合成、不上传任何声音。
- 写入必须配合 `--save` 或 `--save-as`，或在同一个 `run`／MCP 会话内完成。超时不能证明没有副作用：先核对工程、导出文件或原任务。
- 参见[执行权限](skills/filmcraft-use/references/execution-permissions.md)、[运行时架构](docs/FilmCraft-Runtime-Architecture.md)与[领域设计](docs/FilmCraft-Domain-Design.md)。

@full-aigc-plugins/filmcraft README · 故障排查：| 现象 | 处理方式 |
|:---|:---|
| 返回 `unsupported_platform` | 仅支持锁定的 macOS arm64 制品 |
| 读写根被拒绝 | `--read-root` / `--write-root` 必须是你指定的已存在规范目录，不能来自计划 |
| 返回 `runtime_install_busy` | 另一个安装持有锁；等其结束再重试 |
| `--help` 输出没有可用信息 | 本 CLI 使用 `help` |
| 命令丢失对象 ID | 读取真实结果，或保持在同一个 MCP／`run` 会话；不要猜 ID |
| 导出看似完成但未核验 | 解码文件并核对时长、尺寸与音轨 |
| 保存后结果未知 | 检查原工程与回执；不要盲目重新提交 |
